column.description: Text column to match against the pattern
column.title: Column

pattern.description: Python regex with named capture groups (?P<name>...); each group becomes a column '<prefix>_<name>' (or '<column>_<name>'). At most 256 characters (stdlib re has no match timeout; the length cap is the ReDoS guard). Groups whose captures all look numeric are cast to float.
pattern.title: Pattern

prefix.description: Prefix for output columns (default: the source column name)
prefix.title: Prefix

errors.description: Non-null cell with no match: raise, or fill group columns with NaN
errors.title: Errors
